qa.question: If both this Digimon with [Greymon] in its name and an opponent's Digimon are deleted at the same time, will this card's inherited effect activate?
qa.answer: No, it doesn’t.

qa.question: Does this card's inherited effect activate even when a card is trashed from my hand by my my opponent's effect?
qa.answer: Yes, it activates.

qa.question: I used [BT7-112 Susanoomon]'s effect to return 10 Tamer cards and/or cards with the [Hybrid] trait to the bottom of my deck, then I chose to trash [BT7-112 Susanoomon] instead of digivolving it. Does this card's inherited effect still activate in such cases?
qa.answer: No. It doesn't activate in such cases because [BT7-112 Susanoomon] is trashed by the rules, not an effect.

qa.question: If the red Tamer cards among the cards revealed from my deck do not have the [Vaccine] trait, does that mean I can't add any cards to my hand?
qa.answer:
No, even if it does not have the [Vaccine] trait, you can add 1 red Tamer card to your hand.
However, you can't add a red Digimon card to your hand if it doesn't have the [Vaccine] trait.

qa.question: This card’s effect reveals 3 cards. If the cards revealed only include either a red Digimon card with the [Vaccine] trait or a red Tamer card, can I still add a card to my hand?
qa.answer: Yes, as long as either a red Digimon card with the [Vaccine] trait or a red Tamer card is among the cards revealed, you can add it to your hand.

qa.question: This card's effect reveals 3 cards. If both a red Digimon card with the [Vaccine] trait and a red Tamer card are among the cards revealed, can I choose to only add one of them to my hand, and place the remaining cards at the bottom of my deck?
qa.answer: No. This card's effect reads “Add 1 red Digimon card [...] and 1 red Tamer card among them to your hand,” so you must add as many cards to your hand as possible.

qa.question: If both a Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards and my red Tamer are deleted at the same time, does the "gain 1 memory" effect activate?
qa.answer: No, it doesn’t activate.

qa.question: If I attack my opponent using a Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards and my opponent blocks, does this card's inherited effect activate?
qa.answer: Yes. Blocking causes the attack target to be switched, so the effect activates.

qa.answer: This is a special rule for this card that always treats it as if it also has the [Shoutmon] and [Starmons] names.

qa.answer: Yes. Blocking causes the attack target to be switched, so the effect activates.

qa.question: Can I use this card's [On Play] effect to add a card to my hand when only 1 card with the [Xros Heart] trait or [Blue Flare] trait is among the revealed cards?
qa.answer:
Yes, you can.
In such cases, you add as many cards to your hand as possible.

qa.question: Is this card's [Start of Your Turn] effect mandatory?
qa.answer: No, it is optional.

qa.question: Does this card's [My Turn] effect allow this card's [On Deletion] effect to be activated twice when I use one of my Digimon with <Security Attack +1> to check 2 cards in my opponent's security stack?
qa.answer:
No, it doesn't.
This effect is triggered "When a card is removed from your opponent's security stack," so even when you check multiple cards in your opponent's security stack, it is triggered upon the first check, then you choose whether to activate it or not. Also, this is a [Once Per Turn] effect, so if you activate this effect when a card is removed from their security stack upon the first check, you can't activate the effect again upon the next check.

qa.question: Does "with [Avian], [Bird], [Beast], [Animal] or [Sovereign] in one of its traits (other than [Sea Animal])" mean that all traits with the [Avian], [Bird], [Beast], [Animal] or [Sovereign] text other than [Sea Animal] are included regardless of other words or pluralizations?
qa.answer: Yes. Other than [Sea Animal], all traits with [Avian], [Bird], [Beast], [Animal] or [Sovereign] are applicable regardless of other words or pluralizations.

qa.question: What does "For each red Tamer you have in play, add 2000 to the maximum DP of the card you can play by this effect" on this card mean?
qa.answer:
It means that you can use this card's [On Deletion] effect to play "1 red Digimon with [Avian], [Bird], [Beast], [Animal] or [Sovereign] in one of its traits (other than [Sea Animal]), and 3000 DP or less," and if you have a red Tamer when this effect is activated, you add 2000 to the maximum DP for the "3000 DP or less" restriction.
For example, you can play 1 Digimon card with 5000 DP or less if you have 1 red Tamer, and you can play 1 Digimon card with 7000 DP or less if you have 2 red Tamers.

qa.question: Can I use this card's "For each red Tamer you have in play, add 2000 to the maximum DP of the card you can play by this effect" effect to add 2000 to the maximum DP of my Digimon played with effects other than this card's effects?
qa.answer:
No, you can't.
It only affects the [On Deletion] effect on this card itself.

qa.question: If I attack my opponent using this Digimon and my opponent blocks, does this card's [Your Turn] effect activate?
qa.answer: Yes. Blocking causes the attack target to be switched, so the effect activates.

qa.question: What does this card's (Rule) mean, exactly? (*This card's "The name of this card/Digimon is also treated as [OmniShoutmon] and [ZeigGreymon]" has been changed to "(Rule) Name: Also treated as [OmniShoutmon] and [ZeigGreymon].")
qa.answer: This is a special rule for this card that always treats it as if it also has the [OmniShoutmon] and [ZeigGreymon] names.

qa.question: Can I use this card's [On Play] effect to digivolve this card into BT11-018 [Shoutmon DX]?
qa.answer:
No, you can't digivolve it.
You can’t ignore the digivolution requirements.

qa.answer: Yes, as long as either a Digimon card with [Gaogamon] in its name or a blue Tamer card is among the cards revealed, you can add it to your hand.

qa.question: If both a Digimon card with [Gaogamon] in its name and a blue Tamer are among the cards revealed, can I choose to only add one of them to my hand and trash the remaining card using this effect?
qa.answer: No. This card's effect reads “Add 1 Digimon card [...] and 1 blue Tamer card among them to your hand,” so you must add as many cards to your hand as possible.

qa.question: If the cards revealed only include either a Digimon card with [Veedramon] in its name or a blue Tamer card, can I still add a card to my hand using this effect?
qa.answer: Yes, as long as either a Digimon card with [Veedramon] in its name or a blue Tamer card is among the cards revealed, you can add it to your hand.

qa.answer: No. This card's effect reads “Add 1 Digimon card [...] and 1 blue Tamer card among them to your hand,” so you must add as many cards to your hand as possible.

qa.question: What does this card's (Rule) mean, exactly? (*This card's "The name of this card/Digimon is also treated as [MetalGreymon] and [Cyberdramon]" has been changed to "(Rule) Name: Also treated as [MetalGreymon] and [Cyberdramon].")
qa.answer: This is a special rule for this card that always treats it as if it also has the [MetalGreymon] and [Cyberdramon] names.

qa.question: Can I activate this card's "If [Cyberdramon] is in this Digimon's digivolution cards" effect if it has another copy of this card in its digivolution cards?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: Can the [Security] effect of the card added to the hand with this card's "your opponent adds the top card of their security stack to their hand" effect be activated?
qa.answer: No, since the card was not revealed by a security check, its [Security] effect can't be activated.

qa.question: What happens if this Digimon is affected by an effect that forces an attack?
qa.answer:
This Digimon can't attack players, so it will attack one of your opponent's Digimon.
The attack won't be performed in cases where your opponent doesn't have any Digimon that can be attack targets, such as when your opponent doesn't have any suspended Digimon.

qa.question: If this card and one of my purple Digimon or Tamers are deleted at the same time, removing all my purple cards from the battle area, does this card's [On Deletion] effect activate?
qa.answer: No, it doesn’t.

qa.question: Can this card's inherited effect delete an opponent's [Sukamon] to prevent itself from being deleted?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: I have [Sukamon] A and [Sukamon] B with this card in their digivolution cards in the battle area. When [Sukamon] A would be deleted, I attempted to delete [Sukamon] B using this card's inherited effect. On the other hand, when [Sukamon] B would be deleted, I attempted to delete [Sukamon] A using this card's inherited effect. At such times, can [Sukamon] A activate this card's inherited effect again?
qa.answer:
No, it can't be activated.
Until the processing for the 1st activation has resolved, only 1 activation is possible for each immediate-type effect.
In your case, until the deletion of the 1st only [Sukamon] A is resolved, only 1 activation is possible for each "when [...] would" effect, therefore the effect that has already activated for [Sukamon] A can't be activated again.

qa.question: Can this card's inherited effect delete an opponent's [Sukamon] to prevent itself from being deleted?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: I have [Sukamon] A and [Sukamon] B with this card in their digivolution cards in the battle area. On the other hand, when [Sukamon] B would be deleted, I attempted to delete [Sukamon] A using this card's inherited effect. At such times, can [Sukamon] A activate this card's inherited effect again?
qa.answer:
No, it can't be activated.

In your case, until the deletion of the 1st only [Sukamon] A is resolved, only 1 activation is possible for each "when [...] would" effect, therefore the effect that has already activated for [Sukamon] A can't be activated again.

qa.question: What does "You may search your security stack" mean?
qa.answer:
You may look at all the cards in your security stack without revealing them to your opponent.
Then, choose 1 card to add to your hand, reveal only that card to your opponent and add it to your hand.

qa.question: This card that was targeted by [BT11-043 KingSukamon]'s effect and had its name changed to [Sukamon] is deleted. If I have no other [Palmon] in the trash, can I place this same card at the bottom of the digivolution cards of one of my green Digimon from the trash with it's [On Deletion] effect?
qa.answer:
Yes, you can.
The [On Deletion] effect is activated while treated as [Sukamon], but the name changing effect is lost when the card is deleted and placed in the trash, so you can treat this card as a [Palmon] card.

qa.question: Can this card's inherited effect delete an opponent's [Sukamon] to prevent itself from being deleted?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: I have [Sukamon] A and [Sukamon] B with this card in their digivolution cards in the battle area. When [Sukamon] A would be deleted, I attempted to delete [Sukamon] B using this card's inherited effect. On the other hand, when [Sukamon] B would be deleted, I attempted to delete [Sukamon] A using this card's inherited effect. At such times, can [Sukamon] A interrupt this card's inherited effect again?
qa.answer:
No, it can't interrupt it.
Until the processing for the 1st interruption has resolved, only 1 activation is possible for each "when [...] would" effect.
In your case, until the deletion of the 1st only [Sukamon] A is resolved, only 1 interruption is possible for each "when [...] would" effect, so because [Sukamon] A's effect has already interrupted, it can't interrupt again.

qa.question: What does a "change 1 of your opponent's Digimon into a white Digimon with 3000 DP and an original name of [Sukamon]" effect do, exactly?
qa.answer: This effect changes 1 of your opponent's Digimon into a Digimon whose original name is [Sukamon], its original color is white, and its original DP is 3000.

qa.question: If a card such as BT15-035 [Geremon] has a (Rule) that gives it card information, what happens when this card's effect changes it to a white Digimon with an original name of [Sukamon] and 3000 DP?
qa.answer:
The card information gained from the (Rule) will also be changed.
For example, BT15-035 [Geremon]'s (Rule) gives it an original name of [Geremon/Numemon], but if its original card information is changed by this effect, its original name becomes just [Sukamon].

qa.question: If a card such as EX1-005 [Tyrannomon] has an effect that gives it card information, what happens when this card's effect changes it to a white Digimon with an original name of [Sukamon] and 3000 DP?
qa.answer:
The card information gained from the effect remains as-is.
For example, if EX1-005 [Tyrannomon]'s original card information is changed, its original color will become white, and EX1-005 [Tyrannomon]'s effect will also treat it as green, making it a 2-color white and green Digimon.

qa.question: If a card is changed to a white Digimon with an original name of [Sukamon] and 3000 DP, then it digivolves or its top card is trashed by <De-Digivolve> or other effect, what happens to that card's information?
qa.answer: It remains as a white Digimon with 3000 DP and an original name of [Sukamon]. The gained effect is carried over even if the Digimon digivolves or one or more of its top cards are trashed.

qa.question: What happens if a card is changed to a white card with an original name of [Sukamon] and 3000 DP, then its top card is trashed by <De-Digivolve> or other effect and the top card becomes a Tamer or Digi-Egg card?
qa.answer:
It remains changed to a white card with an original name of [Sukamon] and 3000 DP, but any card information that it didn't originally have can't be changed.
If it becomes a Tamer or Digi-Egg card, or if it becomes a card that didn't originally have DP, then it will remain without DP.

qa.question: From the cards revealed with this card's effect, can I choose cards whose total play costs add up to less than 7 on purpose?
qa.answer: Yes, you can choose any number as long as the total play costs add up to 7 or less.

qa.question: When an opponent's Digimon with <Security Attack+1> would check 2 security cards, can I activate this card's [Opponent's Turn] effect "1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -4000 DP" twice?
qa.answer: Yes, you can. This effect is activated every time a security card is checked.

qa.question: What does this card's (Rule) mean, exactly? (*This card's "Treat this card/Digimon as if it also has [Leomon] in its name" has been changed to "(Rule) Name: Also treated as having [Leomon].")
qa.answer:
This is a special rule for this card that always treats it as if it also includes the [Leomon] name.
This card can be chosen for text that specifies cards with [Leomon] in their names.
This card can't be chosen for text that specifies cards with the name [Leomon].

qa.question: If I use this card’s effect when I have 2 green or black Tamer cards, do 2 of my opponent's Digimon suspend and then can't unsuspend during my opponent's next unsuspend phase?
qa.answer:
No, for each green or black Tamer you have in play, this effect suspends 1 of your opponent's Digimon, but only 1 of your opponent's suspended Digimon can't unsuspend during your opponent's next unsuspend phase.
You can choose from your opponent's already suspended Digimon for the target Digimon in addition to the Digimon suspended by this card’s effect.

qa.question: Can I intentionally choose cards with lower costs from among the cards revealed by this card’s effect so that the total play costs add up to less than 10?
qa.answer: Yes, you can choose any of the cards as long as the total play costs add up to 10 or less.

qa.question: Can I use this card's [When Attacking] effect to reveal 2 cards from the top of my deck when I have a green and black 2-color Tamer?
qa.answer:
No, you can't.
A 2-color Tamer still counts as 1 Tamer.

qa.question: Can I use this card's [When Digivolving] effect to trash 3 cards in my hand even when my opponent has 2 or fewer Digimon?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: Can I use this card's effect to reduce the digivolution cost by 2 when I have a green and black 2-color Tamer?
qa.answer:
No, you can't.
A 2-color Tamer still counts as 1 Tamer.

qa.question: If there are no [Snatchmon], [Destromon], [Galactimon], or [Fusionize] among the cards revealed by this card's effect, can I place 1 [Vemmon] under this Digimon as its bottom digivolution card?
qa.answer: Yes, you can place 1 [Vemmon] as a digivolution card even when none of those cards are among the revealed cards.

qa.answer: Yes, as long as either a Digimon card with [Greymon] or [X Antibody] in its name or a black Tamer card is among the cards revealed, you can add it to your hand.

qa.question: If both a Digimon card with [Greymon] or [X Antibody] in its name and a black Tamer are among the cards revealed, can I choose to only add one of them to my hand, and place the remaining cards at the bottom of my deck using this effect?
qa.answer: No. This card's effect reads “Add 1 card [...] and 1 black Tamer card among them to your hand,” so you must add as many cards to your hand as possible.

qa.question: Can I use this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to place a BT11-063 [Geremon] or BT15-035 [Geremon] from my trash in this card's digivolution cards?
qa.answer:
Yes, you can.
BT11-063 [Geremon] and BT15-035 [Geremon] have a rule that also treats them as having the name [Numemon], therefore you can place them as digivolution cards under this Digimon.

qa.question: What does this card's (Rule) mean, exactly? (*This card's "The name of this card/Digimon is also treated as [Numemon]" has been changed to "(Rule) Name: Also treated as [Numemon].")
qa.answer: This is a special rule for this card that always treats it as if it also has the [Numemon] name.

qa.question: Does this card's "When a Digimon becomes unsuspended" inherited effect activate even when my opponent's Digimon becomes unsuspended?
qa.answer: Yes, it activates.

qa.question: What does this card's (Rule) mean, exactly? (*This card's "This card/Digimon is also treated as [DarkKnightmon] and [Tuwarmon]" has been changed to "(Rule) Name: Also treated as [DarkKnightmon] and [Tuwarmon].")
qa.answer: This is a special rule for this card that always treats it as if it also has the [DarkKnightmon] and [Tuwarmon] names.

qa.question: If there is no [Analogman] among the cards revealed by this card's effect, can I add 1 card with the [Cyborg] or [Machine] trait to my hand or place it under this Digimon as its bottom digivolution card?
qa.answer: Yes, you can add 1 card with the [Cyborg] or [Machine] trait to your hand or place it under this Digimon as its bottom digivolution card even when no [Analogman] is among the revealed cards.

qa.question: If there's no [Machinedramon] in my hand, can I place 1 of my [Analogman] at the bottom of its owner's deck with this card's [On Deletion] effect?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: If this Digimon with [BT11-072 Machinedramon] in its digivolution cards is deleted, can I activate the [On Deletion] effect this Digimon gained from [BT11-072 Machinedramon]?
qa.answer:
Yes, you can activate the [On Deletion] effect.
When a Digimon is in the deletion process, it is checked for any [On Deletion] effects. Due to this card's [All Turns] effect, Chaosdramon (X Antibody) is considered to have the [On Deletion] effect of [BT11-072 Machinedramon].

qa.question: An opponent's Digimon without the highest DP attacks, and by using a [When Attacking] effect to increase its DP, it becomes the Digimon with the highest DP. In such cases, can the target of the attack be switched to this Digimon with this card's [Opponent's Turn] effect?
qa.answer:
No, you can't.
If Digimon did not have the highest DP when the attack was declared, this card's [Opponent's Turn] effect can't be activated.

qa.question: Does this card's "When a Digimon becomes unsuspended" effect activate even when my opponent's Digimon becomes unsuspended?
qa.answer: Yes, it activates.

qa.question: If a Digimon card with DigiXros requirements is played by an effect and this card is placed in the digivolution cards by a DigiXros, does this card's inherited effect activate when a Digimon card with this card in its digivolution cards is played by an effect?

qa.question: When this card was played, an already activated DP-reducing effect reduced this card's DP to 0 and deleted it. In such cases, can I activate the [On Play] effect by considering the "By deleting this Digimon" condition to be fulfilled?
qa.answer:
No, you can't.
If its DP is reduced to 0 and it is deleted when played, you can't activate the [On Play] effect. Also, the "By deleting this Digimon" condition is not fulfilled when this Digimon is deleted by another effect or rule.

qa.question: When an effect would delete this Digimon and one of my [Yuu Amano] cards at the same time, does this card’s effect prevent my [Yuu Amano] card from being deleted?
qa.answer: Yes, it is not deleted.

qa.question: With this card's effect, can a blue level 3 Digimon card be played from one of my purple Digimon's digivolution cards, or a purple level 3 Digimon card be played from one of my blue Digimon's digivolution cards?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: [EX3-023 Plesiomon]'s [When Digivolving] effect plays a level 4 Digimon card from digivolution cards and places this card under it as a digivolution card from the hand. At this timing, does this card's inherited effect activate?
qa.answer: No, it does not. Since this card was not a digivolution card when [EX3-023 Plesiomon]'s effect played a level 4 Digimon card from digivolution cards, its inherited effect can't be activated.

qa.question: Does "When you would play this card, you can also place cards from your trash in digivolution cards for a DigiXros" mean that you can place cards from your hand, batle area and trash as digivolution cards for a DigiXros?
qa.answer:
Yes, that's correct.
In addition to Digimon from the hand or battle area, you may also place cards from the trash as digivolution cards for a DigiXros.

qa.question: If this card is played by DigiXrosing, if there's 2 or more purple level 4 or lower Digimon cards or level 4 or lower Digimon cards with the [Xros Heart] trait, can I play only 1 instead?
qa.answer:
No, you can't.
If there are 2 or more cards that can be targeted in your trash, you must either play 2 of them or none.

qa.question: With this card's [On Play] effect, can I place cards under 1 of my Tamers if I didn't add cards with [Bagra Army] in one of their traits from the trash to my hand?
qa.answer:
No you can't.
First you must add 1 or 2 cards with [Bagra Army] in one of their traits from your trash to your hand, and then place 1 or 2 cards with the [Bagra Army] trait under one of your Tamers. If you don't add cards to your hand, you can't place cards under your Tamer.

qa.question: If I use this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to place an opponent's Digimon under my opponent's other Digimon as its bottom digivolution card, will the Digimon to be placed in digivolution cards leave the battle area?
qa.answer:
Yes, it will leave the battle area.
The digivolution cards of the Digimon to be placed in digivolution cards will be trashed at the same time.

qa.question: If I use this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to place BT12-038 [GeoGreymon] as the bottom digivolution card of an opponent's BT17-087 [Marcus Damon] that's treated as a Digimon, does that BT17-087 [Marcus Damon] gain BT12-038 [GeoGreymon]'s inherited effect?
qa.answer:
Yes, it gains the inherited effect.
If BT17-087 [Marcus Damon] suspends, BT12-038 [GeoGreymon]'s inherited effect will trigger. However, as soon as it is no longer treated as a Digimon, it will lose inherited effects.

qa.question: Can I use this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to place 1 of my opponent's Digimon under another of their Digimon that isn't affected by effects?
qa.answer: No, you can't.

qa.question: Does "with [Avian], [Bird], [Beast], [Animal] or [Sovereign] in one of its traits (other than [Sea Animal])" mean that all traits with the [Avian], [Bird], [Beast], [Animal] or [Sovereign] text other than [Sea Animal] are included regardless of other words or pluralizations?
qa.answer: Yes. Other than [Sea Animal], all traits with [Avian], [Bird], [Beast], [Animal] or [Sovereign] are applicable regardless of other words or pluralizations.

qa.question: Can I activate this card's [Start of Your Main Phase] effect if an effect at the start of my turn or during my unsuspend phase or breeding phase causes the memory counter to move to my opponent's side and it becomes my opponent's turn?
qa.answer: No, it doesn't activate if it becomes your opponent's turn before your main phase.

qa.question: Can I activate this card's [Start of Your Main Phase] effect if an effect at the start of my turn or during my unsuspend phase or breeding phase causes the memory counter to move to my opponent's side and it becomes my opponent's turn?
qa.answer: No, it doesn't activate if it becomes your opponent's turn before your main phase.

qa.question: An opponent's Digimon attacks me directly, and activates the effect of <Raid> to switch the attack to a Digimon. In such cases, can I still switch the attack target with this card's [Opponent's Turn] effect?
qa.answer: Yes, if your opponent declared an attack against you when declaring their attack target, you can still switch the attack target.

qa.question: My Digimon is affected by this card's "isn't affected by your opponent's Option cards" effect. Is it affected by the [Security] effect of my opponent's Option cards?
qa.answer: No, it isn't affected.

qa.question: My opponent uses [EX1-068 Ice Wall!] while one of my Digimon is affected by this card's "isn't affected by your opponent's Option cards" effect. If it becomes my next turn and this card's effect expires, will that Digimon have the "[When Attacking] Lose 2 memory" effect?
qa.answer: Yes, this card's "isn't affected by your opponent's Option cards" effect expires while the effect of [EX1-068 Ice Wall!] is still active, so that Digimon will have [EX1-068 Ice Wall!]'s "[When Attacking] Lose 2 memory" effect.

qa.question: My opponent uses [EX1-068 Ice Wall!] and I activate this card's "isn't affected by your opponent's Option cards" effect on one of my Digimon that has "[When Attacking] Lose 2 memory". What happens with the "[When Attacking] Lose 2 memory" effect in such cases?
qa.answer: Since that Digimon isn't affected by your opponent's Option cards anymore, [EX1-068 Ice Wall!]'s "[When Attacking] Lose 2 memory" effect ends.

qa.question: What does this card's [Your Turn] effect mean?
qa.answer: This effect means that, if one of your Digimon digivolves into [Angewomon], you may play [LadyDevimon] from your hand without paying the cost, or if one of your Digimon digivolves into [LadyDevimon], you may play [Angewomon] from your hand without paying the cost.

qa.question: Can I play [Angewomon] if one of my Digimon digivolves into [Angewomon], or [LadyDevimon] if one of my Digimon digivolves into [LadyDevimon] with this card's [Your Turn] effect?
qa.answer: No, you can't.

qa.question: Can I activate this card's [Start of Your Main Phase] effect if an effect at the start of my turn or during my unsuspend phase or breeding phase causes the memory counter to move to my opponent's side and it becomes my opponent's turn?
qa.answer: No, it doesn't activate if it becomes your opponent's turn before your main phase.

qa.question: What does this card's "by suspending this Tamer, you may place cards from under your Tamers as digivolution cards for a DigiXros" effect do, exactly?
qa.answer: When you play a Digimon card with DigiXros requirements, normally you can only DigiXros with Digimon from your hand or battle area. However, this effect also allows you to DigiXros with Digimon cards placed under a Tamer.

qa.question: Does this card's [Your Turn] effect also allow me to DigiXros with cards placed under a Tamer other than this Tamer?
qa.answer: Yes, it does.

qa.question: Does this card's [Your Turn] effect also allow me to DigiXros using the digivolution cards of a Digimon that digivolved from a Tamer?
qa.answer: No, it doesn't.

qa.question: Can I activate this card's effect when I would play 2 or more Digimon with DigiXros requirements with an effect at the same time?
qa.answer: No, since this card's effect reads "When you would play 1 Digimon card with DigiXros requirements", if you would play 2 or more Digimon cards at the same time, you can't activate the effect.

qa.question: Can I activate this card's effect when I play 1 Digimon card with DigiXros requirements and other Digimon cards without DigiXros requirements with an effect at the same time?
qa.answer:
No you can't.
This effect can only be activated when you would play 1 Digimon card with DigiXros conditions.

qa.question: If I don't have any Digimon with [Seadramon] in its name, and use this card's effect to play a Digimon card Seadramon] in its name from the digivolution cards of one of my blue Digimon, does the effect to "return 1 of your opponent's level 4 or lower Digimon to the bottom of its owner's deck" activate?
qa.answer: Yes, the effect will activate since a Digimon with [Seadramon] in its name was played earlier.

qa.question: Can I suspend only 1 of my opponent's Digimon, or none of their Digimon, if I use this card's effect while they have 2 or more Digimon that can be suspended?
qa.answer:
No, you can't.
The effect reads "Suspend 2 of your opponent's Digimon", so suspend 2 as possible.

qa.question: Can I attack one of my opponent's unsuspended Digimon with this card's effect?
qa.answer: No you can't

qa.question: Can I place 1 [Vemmon] under one of my Digimon's digivolution cards with this card's effect even if there's no [Destromon] or [Galacticmon] in my trash?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: Can I choose cards so that the combined play cost is lower than the play cost of 1 of my Digimon with [Greymon] in their name on purpose with this card's effect?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: Can I attack with one of my Digimon with [Greymon] in its name that is suspended or was played this turn with this card's effect?
qa.answer:
No, you can't.
This card's effect does not allow you to attack with Digimon that can't attack.

qa.question: Does the [When Attacking] effect of my Digimon with [Greymon] in its name activates when it attacks with this card's effect?
qa.answer: Yes, it activates.

qa.question: Can I attack one of my opponent's Digimon instead of a player with one of my Digimon with [Greymon] in its name that has the effect "This Digimon can also attack your opponent's unsuspended Digimon" with this card's effect?
qa.answer:
No, you can't.
This card's effect only allows you to attack a player.

qa.question: Can I use option cards that can change their cost to 7 on certain conditions such as [BT7-100 Qualialise Blast] or [BT11-108 DG Dimension] with this card’s [On Play] effect?
qa.answer:
No, you can’t. Since those options are cards that have effects that “reduce the cost by…” or “its memory cost is equal to…” when they would be used, their cost has not actually changed when activating this card’s [On Play] effect, so they can’t be used with this card’s effect.
However, since [BT2-099 Glorious Burst] always has the effect of reducing its use cost when used from the hand, if you have 2 yellow Tamers, it can be used with this card’s effect as its use cost will be 7.

qa.question: Can I use this card's [Main] effect to place 1 of my opponent's Digimon under another of their Digimon that isn't affected by effects?
qa.answer: No, you can't.

qa.question: If I use this card's [Main] effect to place an opponent's Digimon under my opponent's other Digimon as its bottom digivolution card, will the Digimon to be placed in digivolution cards leave the battle area?
qa.answer:
Yes, it will leave the battle area.
The digivolution cards of the Digimon to be placed in digivolution cards will be trashed at the same time.

qa.question: Can I activate this card's [All Turns] effect and place 4 [Vemmon] at the bottom of their owners' decks to prevent it from leaving the battle area when this Digimon is affected by a <De-Digivolve> effect?
qa.answer:
No, you can't.
<De-Digivolve> is not considered an effect where a Digimon would leave the battle area.

qa.question: What does this card's "When this Digimon would leave the battle area" mean, exactly?
qa.answer: "When [...] would leave the battle area" refers to when this Digimon is placed in the trash, returned to the hand/deck, placed in the security stack, moved to the breeding area, or placed under another card.

qa.question: Can I activate this card's [All Turns] effect and place 4 [Vemmon] at the bottom of their owners' decks to prevent it from leaving the battle area when this Digimon is returned to my deck or placed in my security stack?
qa.answer: Yes, you can activate it when this Digimon is affected by effect that moves it to one of those areas.

qa.question: Can I activate this card's [Start of Your Main Phase] effect if an effect at the start of my turn or during my unsuspend phase or breeding phase causes the memory counter to move to my opponent's side and it becomes my opponent's turn?
qa.answer: No, it doesn't activate if it becomes your opponent's turn before your main phase.

qa.question: When one of my Digimon with [Veedramon] in its name without a [When Digivolving] effect becomes suspended, can I suspend this card?
qa.answer: Yes you can. In such cases, even if there's no [When Digivolving] effect to target with this effect, this card still becomes suspended.

qa.question: My Digimon with [Veedramon] in its name attacks and becomes suspended. After that, it digivolves into a different Digimon with the [When Attacking] effect of [BT9-109 X Antibody] in its digivolution cards. If the card it digivolved into has a [When Digivolving], if I suspend this card with this card's [All Turns] effect, can I activate the [When Digivolving] effect of the card it digivolved into?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

comprehensive-0223.title: <Blocker>
comprehensive-0223.text:
16-5. <Blocker>
16-5-1. <Blocker> is a keyword effect that applies a rule that allows a Digimon with that effect to block. (For details, refer to 12 "Blocking")
16-5-2. <Blocker> is a persistent effect. (For details, refer to 15-8-2 "Persistent Effects")
16-5-3. Even if 1 Digimon has multiple instances of <Blocker>, the number of blocks that can be performed during the block timing is only 1.

comprehensive-0224.title: <Recovery>
comprehensive-0224.text:
16-6. <Recovery>
16-6-1. <Recovery> is a keyword effect where the specified number of cards from the specified area are placed face down on top of the security stack. This is shown on cards using text such as <Recovery +1>.
16-6-2. <Recovery> effects execute processing.

comprehensive-0225.title: <Piercing>
comprehensive-0225.text:
16-7. <Piercing>
16-7-1. <Piercing> is a keyword effect that reads "When this Digimon deletes your opponent's Digimon in battle while attacking, it checks security before the attack ends." (For details, refer to 13 "Security Checks")
16-7-2. <Piercing> is a trigger-type effect that triggers and activates when a Digimon with this effect battles an opponent's Digimon and the opponent's Digimon is deleted in battle. (For details, refer to 15-8-3 "Trigger- Type Effects")
16-7-3. The security check from using <Piercing> is mandatory.
16-7-4. <Piercing> is pending processing that is processed immediately before the transition to the end of attack timing. Therefore, it will trigger simultaneously with effects triggered by the battle, but it is processed before the end of the attack. (Example: If a Digimon with <Piercing> attacks and deletes a Digimon with an [On Deletion] effect in the battle, first the [On Deletion] effect is resolved, then <Piercing> is processed.)
16-7-5. Only 1 security check can be performed during a single attack, even if <Piercing> activates multiple times. However, if the number of cards that can be checked by the attacking Digimon is modified, that number of cards will be checked in a single security check.
16-7-6. If there are no Digimon to perform a security check at the point when <Piercing> is processed, a security check won't be possible.

comprehensive-0226.title: <Draw>
comprehensive-0226.text:
16-8. <Draw>
16-8-1. <Draw> is a keyword effect where a player draws the cards from their deck according to the number specified in the effect. This is shown on cards using text such as <Draw 1>.
16-8-2. <Draw> effects execute processing.
16-8-3. A draw from <Draw> is mandatory.

comprehensive-0227.title: <Jamming>
comprehensive-0227.text:
16-9. <Jamming>
16-9-1. <Jamming> is a keyword effect where a Digimon with this effect isn't deleted as a result of a battle with an opponent's Security Digimon.
16-9-2. <Jamming> is a persistent effect. (For details, refer to 15-8-2 "Persistent Effects")

comprehensive-0229.title: <Reboot>
comprehensive-0229.text:
16-11. <Reboot>
16-11-1. <Reboot> is a keyword effect where a Digimon with this effect is unsuspended during the opponent's unsuspend phase.
16-11-2. <Reboot> is a persistent effect. (For details, refer to 15-8-2 "Persistent Effects")
16-11-3. Even if 1 Digimon has multiple instances of <Reboot>, it is only unsuspended once during the opponent's unsuspend phase.
16-11-4. The unsuspending from <Reboot> is mandatory.
16-11-5. The unsuspending from <Reboot> is performed at the same time as the unsuspending of the turn player's Digimon. The unsuspends aren't performed in any particular order.

comprehensive-0230.title: <De-Digivolve>
comprehensive-0230.text:
16-12. <De-Digivolve>
16-12-1. <De-Digivolve> is a keyword effect where the player declares a number from 1 up to the number specified in the effect, then the declared number of cards are trashed from the chosen stack(s) of cards starting with the top card. This is shown on cards using text such as <De- Digivolve 1>.
16-12-2. <De-Digivolve> effects execute processing.
16-12-3. The trashing from <De-Digivolve> is mandatory. Once activated, a player can't choose to trash 0 cards.
16-12-4. <De-Digivolve> can't trash cards from level 3 cards or lower.
16-12-5. If multiple cards are trashed using 1 instance of <De- Digivolve>, all of the cards are considered to be trashed at the same time, but the procedure for trashing them is 1 card from the stack at a time.
16-12-6. When using <De-Digivolve> to trash multiple cards, even if the category of the top card changes while the trashing is still being performed, the trashing will continue until the declared number is trashed.
16-12-7. When separate instances of <De-Digivolve> are executed multiple times in a single effect, the processing is performed separately for each instance.
16-12-8. When separate instances of <De-Digivolve> are executed multiple times in a single effect, the state of the chosen card is confirmed after each single process for <De-Digivolve> ends. If an effect will be activated as a result of the confirmed state, it is then activated. (Example: When 3 instances of <De-Digivolve 1> are executed in a single effect, if the chosen card becomes an "unaffected by effects" card as a result of the 1st instance of <De-Digivolve 1>, that card is unaffected by the following instances of <De-Digivolve 1>.

comprehensive-0231.title: <Retaliation>
comprehensive-0231.text:
16-13. <Retaliation>
16-13-1. <Retaliation> is a keyword effect where a battled opponent's Digimon is deleted when a Digimon with this effect is deleted in battle.
16-13-2. <Retaliation> is a trigger-type effect that triggers when just the Digimon with this effect is deleted in battle. (For details, refer to 15-8-3 "Trigger-Type Effects")
16-13-3. The processing from <Retaliation> is mandatory.

comprehensive-0233.title: <Rush>
comprehensive-0233.text:
16-15. <Rush>
16-15-1. <Rush> is a keyword effect where the Digimon with this effect can also attack in the same turn it was played.
16-15-2. <Rush> is a persistent effect. (For details, refer to 15-8-2 "Persistent Effects")

comprehensive-0234.title: <Blitz>
comprehensive-0234.text:
16-16. <Blitz>
16-16-1. <Blitz> is a keyword effect where a Digimon with this effect can attack if your opponent has 1 or more memory.
16-16-2. <Blitz> effects execute processing.
16-16-3. <Blitz> has a processing condition that requires the memory to be at 1 or more on your opponent's side. "This Digimon may attack" is optional processing.
16-16-4. After using <Blitz> to make an attack declaration, the attack will proceed even if the memory moves to 0 or more.38
16-16-5. An attack can't be made using <Blitz> if the memory is at 0 or more upon activating <Blitz>.

comprehensive-0236.title: <Decoy>
comprehensive-0236.text:
16-18. <Decoy>
16-18-1. <Decoy> is a keyword effect. When another of your specified Digimon would be deleted by an opponent's effect, by deleting the Digimon with this effect, <Decoy> prevents the Digimon specified by this effect from being deleted. This is shown on cards using text such as <Decoy (Black)>.
16-18-2. <Decoy> is an immediate-type effect that triggers when another of your Digimon specified by this effect would be deleted by an opponent's effect (For details, refer to 15-8-5 "Immediate-Type Effects")
16-18-3. "By deleting this Digimon" in <Decoy> is an optional processing condition. If the content of that condition is executed, the processing for "<Decoy> prevents the Digimon specified by this effect from being deleted" will be mandatory.

comprehensive-0237.title: <Armor Purge>
comprehensive-0237.text:
16-19. <Armor Purge>
16-19-1. <Armor Purge> is a keyword effect. When a Digimon with <Armor Purge> would be deleted, by trashing the top card of the Digimon with this effect, this effect prevents the deletion.
16-19-2. <Armor Purge> is an immediate-type effect that triggers when the Digimon with this effect would be deleted. (For details, refer to 15-8-5 "Immediate-Type Effects")
16-19-3. "By trashing the top card of the Digimon" in <Armor Purge> is an optional processing condition. If the content of that condition is executed, the processing for "prevents the deletion" will be mandatory.

comprehensive-0238.title: <Save>
comprehensive-0238.text:
16-20. <Save>
16-20-1. <Save> is a keyword effect that allows you to place this card under 1 of your Tamers.
16-20-2. <Save> effects execute processing.
16-20-3. The processing from <Save> is optional.

comprehensive-0239.title: <Material Save>
comprehensive-0239.text:
16-21. <Material Save>
16-21-1. <Material Save> is a keyword effect. When a Digimon with this effect is deleted, this effect allows you to place a number of the cards specified in the top card's DigiXros requirements from among the digivolution cards under 1 of your Tamers. The number of cards placed is the number specified in this keyword effect. This is shown on cards using text such as <Material Save 1>.
16-21-2. <Material Save> is an immediate-type effect that triggers when the Digimon with this effect would be deleted. (For details, refer to 15-8-5 "Immediate-Type Effects")
16-21-3. The processing from <Material Save> is optional. However, if <Material Save> will be processed, the number of cards specified by this effect must be placed under your Tamer whenever possible.
16-21-4. When multiple cards would be placed under 1 Tamer for 1 instance of <Material Save>, the procedure for placing them is 1 card at a time, but they are considered to be placed at the same time. In addition, the placement order is chosen by the player processing <Material Save>.
16-21-5. As long as you use a card specified in the DigiXros requirements, multiple copies of the same card can be placed under the Tamer for <Material Save>. (Example: If a Digimon with <Material Save 2> has [Shoutmon]×[Ballistamon]×[Dorulumon] in its DigiXros requirements, 2 copies of [Shoutmon] can be placed under the Tamer.)

comprehensive-0241.title: <Evade>
comprehensive-0241.text:
16-22. <Evade>
16-22-1. <Evade> is a keyword effect. By suspending a Digimon with this effect when it would be deleted, this effect prevents the deletion.
16-22-2. <Evade> is an immediate-type effect that triggers when the Digimon with this effect would be deleted. (For details, refer to 15-8-5 "Immediate-Type Effects")
16-22-3. "By suspending a Digimon with this effect" in <Evade> is an optional processing condition. If the content of that condition is executed, the processing for "prevents the deletion" will be mandatory.

comprehensive-0242.title: <Raid>
comprehensive-0242.text:
16-23. <Raid>
16-23-1. <Raid> is a keyword effect that can switch the target of attack to the opponent's unsuspended Digimon with the highest DP when a Digimon with this keyword effect attacks.
16-23-2. <Raid> is a trigger-type effect that triggers when a Digimon with this effect attacks. (For details, refer to 15-8-3 "Trigger-Type Effects")
16-23-3. The processing from <Raid> is optional.
16-23-4. If the opponent has multiple unsuspended Digimon with the highest DP when <Raid> activates, the player that activated the effect chooses a Digimon from among them and the attack target is switched to it.

comprehensive-0292.title: Stacked Cards
comprehensive-0292.text:
4-7. Stacked Cards
4-7-1. "Stacked cards" refers to all of the 1 or more cards in a10 stack of cards on the field.
4-7-2. Only 1 card isn't considered "stacked cards."
4-7-3. The stacking order of cards can't be changed.
4-7-4. The bottom cards of a stack are spread out so that inherited effects are visible. A card without an inherited effect is placed in the stack so that its name is visible. A face-down card must be stacked so that it's clearly under the top card.
4-7-5. Unless specified otherwise, the bottom cards of a stack are placed face-up.
4-7-6. Bottom cards of a stack are placed vertically, but they don't have an orientation. When the bottom card of a stack becomes the top card, the stack's previous orientation is carried over. This isn't considered unsuspending or suspending of a card. (Example: When <De-Digivolve 1> is used to trash the top card of a suspended Digimon, the top card of the stack under it will carry over the suspended state.)
4-7-7. The bottom cards of a stack are treated as part of the information on the top card. They aren't considered to be placed on the field. (Example: When "[When Digivolving] Place one of your opponent's level 3 or lower Digimon under another of your opponent's Digimon as its bottom digivolution card or under an opponent's Tamer" is used to place a Digimon under a card, that card is considered to be removed from the field.)

comprehensive-0293.title: Stacked Cards
comprehensive-0293.text:
4-7-8. When a card with cards stacked under it would be removed from the field, the cards under it are trashed at the same time. (Example: When a Digimon or Tamer would be removed from the battle area, any cards under it are trashed at the same time.)
4-7-9. A face-down card under another card is considered to be a card without card information, and its information can't be referenced. (Example: When a face-down digivolution card is placed for <Training>, information such as its card name or color can't be referenced for other effects.)
4-7-10. A face-down card under another card is hidden information, but the cards' owner may freely look at the content of a face-down card under one of their cards.
